announcements.headline: Temporary suspension of production
announcements.insight: Production restart in September was reversed by a temporary suspension. Shareholders should monitor for further operational updates.

announcements.headline: Result of Meeting
announcements.insight: The meeting results follow the September circular notice. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for outcomes of the general meeting.

announcements.headline: Interim Results for the six months to 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Interim results for the six months to 30 June 2026 are released. This follows a US$100 million equity fundraise and production restart in September 2026.

announcements.headline: Results of General Meeting and Total Voting Rights
US$15 Million Loan Facility from Fevamotinico
announcements.insight: Following the September fundraise, this loan facility supports operations. It complements the restart of production at Ukrainian sites announced in September.

announcements.headline: Restart of production at Ukrainian operations
announcements.insight: Production restart follows the September fundraise, likely funding operations. This operational recovery is critical for utilizing the raised capital.

announcements.headline: Publication of Circular, notice of GM and 2025 ARA
announcements.insight: The GM and ARA follow the September fundraise results. Shareholders should watch for voting outcomes on these routine governance items.

announcements.headline: Results of Fundraise
announcements.insight: The fundraise follows the September proposal to raise US$100 million. Shareholders should monitor progress on resolving logistics disruptions and operational updates.

announcements.headline: Proposed equity fundraise to raise US$100 million
announcements.insight: Following suspension and operational updates, a US$100 million equity fundraise addresses liquidity needs arising from recent logistics disruptions.

announcements.headline: Full Year Financial Results for 2025
announcements.insight: FXPO published full year financial results for 2025. This follows earlier updates on logistics disruption and vessel incidents in July and August 2026.
